entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh right, today's Valentine's Day.[n]No wonder there were so many guys[n]bringing girls in here.
entries.uk: А, точно, сьогодні ж День святого[n]Валентина. То ось чому сюди стільки[n]хлопців із дівчатами приходило.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't you have anything exciting[n]happening? I mean, you've been here[n]nearly a whole year.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Y'know, when I was young, hoo boy...
entries.uk: От коли я був молодий, ого-го...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Ohhh... You should've just told me.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Here, I'll leave the store to you.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm sorry. You must be tired.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I just really wanted some time alone[n]with you...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But can I say one thing?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Well... I'd like to say yes, but...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...I suppose I don't need to ask for[n]an apology, then.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: When I realized you were gone, I was...[n]honestly terrified.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I was so scared I'd lost you forever.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Good! They came out quite well, if I say[n]so myself. At least, I think so...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Well, I didn't begin quite that early[n]in the process...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But it sounds like a lovely idea. Perhaps[n]next year I'll grow some cacao!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I know it's a bit late to ask, but...[n]We're back now, right? In our proper[n]reality?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I've received an unofficial offer from[n]Okumura Foods.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Ah, but I haven't given up on my dream[n]of a humble café.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I think I ought to work as an ordinary[n]employee first. That should help me[n]learn some vital lessons.
I know you can do it.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: May I sit next to you...?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Apologies if I'm being too forward...[n]This is just so calming.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We've agreed to work through this.[n]Now we'll just have to do our best.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: When I joined the Phantom Thieves,[n]I wanted to be someone who helped[n]those in need.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I imagined myself as my childhood[n]heroines. Champions of justice.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But I found something more than that.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Now, I've got someone in my heart.[n]I'll do whatever it takes to make them[n]happy.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: And it's not about justice, or any[n]high ideals. It's about what I want.
I spent a romantic evening[n]with Haru...
